derivation: from a compound of G5043 (τέκνον) and G5142 (τρέφω);
def: to be a childrearer, i.e. fulfil the duties of a female parent

occurrences.text: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
